New Sidebar Navigation: We swapped the pop-out sidebar for an icon rail that stays pinned to the side while you browse.
Cleaned up the login and profile menus so they only show sign-in options we support.
Manage Your Profile: You can now change your username right from your profile, and we'll let you know if one's already taken.
Deleting your account now lives in the new profile panel too.
Grades Are Optional: You can post a review without picking a grade now.
Better Link Previews: Shared MonSTAR links now show a preview image with our mascots.

A Faster, More Reliable MonSTAR: We rebuilt MonSTAR's backend for better stability and fewer errors.
Cleared out old code behind the scenes so new features land sooner.

Student Roles Board!: A really cool feature, that makes MonSTAR your go to place to find university student teams, clubs and societies that are looking for students in various roles.
Thanks to @openuniroles we were able to integrate their data into a beautiful student roles board.
New Login and Profile Page: We migrated from a ugly profile dialog to a full page layout.
Added a new full page login page.
Added new full page profile pages for all users, you can view other peoples profiles and their contributions.

Faster, More Reliable Hosting: We moved MonSTAR to hosting that scales with demand, so it stays fast when lots of students are online at once.

Better Unit Browsing: Sorting by lowest rating now shows units that have reviews first.
Unit cards now line up in even rows, and long unit names no longer spill over their cards.
This Changelog!: Added the page you're reading now, a timeline of everything new on MonSTAR.
SETU Insights for Students: SETU survey overviews now sit behind a quick sign-in, keeping the data within the Monash student community.
Gave the homepage a new look with gradient text and a new font.

AI Unit Overviews: Added AI overviews: short summaries of each unit written by Gemini 2.5 Pro.
Each summary shows which model wrote it and when.
Smoother UI: Added loading skeletons while data loads, plus spacing and tooltip fixes across the app.

User Profiles: Added user profile pages where your contributions live.

SETU Survey Overviews: Launched SETU survey overview pages with charts and a carousel for exploring how units score.
Manage Your Reviews: You can now edit and delete your reviews right from your profile.
Meet the Contributors: Added a contributors section to the About page listing everyone who's helped build MonSTAR.

Unit Overview Refresh: Gave unit overview pages a full-page layout and fixed some annoying scrolling issues.
Added circular knob dials for SETU metrics.
Sped up how SETU data loads.

Handy Touches: Unit codes in reviews are now clickable links to that unit.
You can now sort reviews by likes and dislikes to find the most helpful ones first.

Notifications: Added notifications with badges for replies and updates.
Smarter Reviews: Editing reviews now happens in a dedicated dialog, and you can post one review per unit.
About Page & Wider Sign-In: Added an About page introducing the team behind MonSTAR.
Opened sign-in to Monash staff and masters email addresses.

Unit Map: Introduced the Unit Map, an interactive graph of how units connect through prerequisites and what they unlock.
Zoom, reset, re-center, and switch layouts from the toolbar, with tooltips on each control.
Prettier Unit Cards: Unit cards now show credit points, prerequisites, tags, and offering details, and load faster.
Popular units now get tagged so they're easier to find.
Richer Reviews: Reviews got clearer like and dislike colours, compact rating circles, and a Report Review button.
Renamed the rating categories to Enjoyment, Simplicity, and Usefulness.
Your Account, Your Control: Added a Delete Account option in Profile Settings, and fixed a bug with Google profile pictures.
Terms & Conditions: Added a Terms and Conditions page based on Monash's Student Code of Conduct.
Better on Every Screen: Reworked the app for tablets and phones, with responsive sign-in forms and a mobile-friendly sidebar.
A Friendlier Home Page: Jazzed up the home page with animated floating emotes and a rotating set of subheaders.

Review Filtering: Added advanced review filters that remember your preferences between visits.
Easier Sign-In: Added Google One-Tap sign-in for faster login.
Password Recovery & Profiles: Added a 'Forgot Password' flow and a reviews section on your profile.

MonSTAR v1.0 is Live!: Launched MonSTAR with the essentials: sign in, write and manage unit reviews, and like or dislike others' reviews.
Early Polish: Improved profile dialogs and account management, and added loading skeletons.

Project Genesis: Where MonSTAR began. We set up the platform, built the first review cards and the write-a-review popup, and laid the foundations for Monash student sign-in.
